headline: A tense moment as the game stays tied
what_happened: The Indianapolis team decided to punt, which means they kicked the ball away to Kansas City instead of trying to move further down the field on their fourth and final try.
who: R.Sanchez kicked the ball and N.Remigio caught it for Kansas City.
why_it_matters: This was bad news for Indianapolis because their chance of winning dropped significantly. Since the score is tied, Kansas City now has a chance to make a big play with very little time left.
